# PrivaTools — Content Reference

This optional reference describes public product content. It contains no account records, uploads, or API credentials. It does not guarantee inclusion in any AI answer or search result.

PrivaTools offers 222 tools for PDFs, images, video, audio, documents, archives, and developer tasks. The source is MIT-licensed and can be self-hosted.

## Processing and accounts

- Everyday tools and downloads are available without signing in. Accounts manage identity and developer API keys.
- Processing depends on the tool: browser-only utilities keep the input on the device; server tools upload files for isolated temporary processing in temporary per-request storage.
- Server cleanup is designed to remove temporary input and output after the response, with a background sweep for leftover files. This is a cleanup policy, not a claim of forensic erasure or instantaneous cleanup after every failure.
- AI Studio offers on-device models and user-selected external providers. Provider mode sends the selected content to that provider and may incur its own charges. Smart Redact detects locally, then uploads the PDF and approved terms to apply redactions.
- The current Vault, saved signatures, and tool preferences are browser-local. Signing in does not sync them across devices or back them up.
- Public processing has file-size, rate, resource, and tool-specific limits. Available native codecs and AI models depend on the deployment. Self-hosting has its own infrastructure costs.
- PrivaTools does not add a promotional watermark to downloads. Watermark tools add marks only when requested.
- Public pages use Google Analytics, on by default, for page visits, sessions, engagement, where visits come from and tool runs: which tool, how it ran, how many files, whether it succeeded and, for most failed runs, a fixed failure category such as "too_large" or "server". Where a visit came from is the referring site's origin, or the PrivaTools page it was opened from, and any standard utm_ campaign tags, sent only with the first page view of each page load and filtered by rules meant to keep out phone numbers, identifiers and tokens. It receives no file contents, filenames, document text, error messages or account identity; advertising features and Google Signals are off. Browsers that identify themselves as automated or headless are not measured. Visitors can turn analytics off on the privacy page.

## Authoritative pages

- [All tools](https://privatools.me/tools): Browse the current catalogue and each tool's processing notice.
- [Trust center](https://privatools.me/trust): Understand local, server, and provider processing.
- [Privacy](https://privatools.me/privacy): File handling, account data, and telemetry.
- [Security](https://privatools.me/security): Security boundaries and reporting.
- [Developer API](https://privatools.me/api): API access and key management.
- [API operation catalog](https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/operations): Public machine-readable operations, request fields, response media types, current costs, limits, and async availability. Browser-only website tools are listed as unavailable through HTTP.
- [Versioned OpenAPI](https://api.privatools.me/api/v1/openapi.json): The public v1 contract for developer and AI/workflow integrations. Processing requires a PrivaTools API key; discovery does not.
- [About](https://privatools.me/about): Project context and source code.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ethereaglehq/privatools): Implementation and issue tracker.

## Tool reference

### Merge PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/merge-pdf

Combine multiple PDFs into one

Merge PDF files online for free — combine multiple PDF documents into a single file in seconds. Drag files into order and choose which pages of each to include, by thumbnail or page range. Up to 100 files and 500 MB in total, no sign-up, no watermarks. Files are processed in temporary storage and cleaned up after the response.

### Split PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/split-pdf

Split by selecting specific page ranges

Split PDF online for free — pull the page ranges you choose into a new PDF, split every page into its own file, or cut the document into equal parts. No installation, no registration required. Files are processed in temporary storage and cleaned up after the response.

### Split by Bookmarks

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/split-by-bookmarks

Split at pages where bookmarks point to

Split PDF by bookmarks or chapters automatically. Each top-level bookmark marks where a part starts, and every section becomes a separate PDF. Ideal for splitting textbooks, manuals, and reports. Free, private, no sign-up.

### Split by Size

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/split-by-size

Split into parts based on a max file size

Split large PDFs into smaller files by maximum file size. Perfect for email attachments with size limits. Set your target size (e.g., 10 MB) and automatically split into compliant chunks. Free online tool, no registration.

### Split in Half

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/split-in-half

Split each page in half — for two-up scans & book spreads

Split each PDF page in half down the middle (or across the middle) — perfect for scanned book spreads, two-up scans, and side-by-side documents that need to be one page per side. Choose vertical (left+right) or horizontal (top+bottom).

### Organize Pages

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/organize-pages

Reorder or delete pages visually

Rearrange PDF pages online — drag and drop page thumbnails to reorder them and remove the pages you do not need. Free PDF page organizer with no watermarks. Preview every page before saving.

### Delete Pages

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/delete-pages

Remove specific pages from a PDF

Remove pages from PDF online for free. Select specific pages or ranges to delete. Preview thumbnails and choose exactly which pages to remove. No sign-up, no watermarks; files are cleaned up after processing.

### Extract Pages

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/extract-pages

Extract specified pages to a new document

Extract pages from PDF online — save specific pages as a new PDF file. Select individual pages or ranges to pull out while keeping the original document intact. Free, fast, and private.

### Edit PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/edit-pdf

Add text, shapes, highlights and images to a PDF

Edit PDF online for free — add text, freehand ink, highlights, shapes, arrows, whiteout and images to your pages without converting to Word first. Existing text and images stay as they are; the editor adds new content on top. No watermarks are added.

### Sign PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/sign-pdf

Add a visual signature image to a PDF

Add signature to PDF online for free. Draw or upload your signature image and place it anywhere on the document. Sign without printing; the signature is placed as an image, not as a certificate-based digital signature. No account required.

### Watermark

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/watermark

Add text or image watermark over PDF pages

Add watermark to PDF online for free. Apply text or image watermarks to every page with control over opacity, position, and font size or image scale; centred, diagonal and tiled text runs at a 45° angle. Clearly mark drafts and confidential copies. No sign-up needed.

### Header & Footer

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/header-footer

Add a header and footer to every page

Add headers and footers to PDF online. Insert custom text, such as a title, a date, or company information, in the header and footer of every page of your PDF. The same text repeats on each page. Free tool with an adjustable font size.

### Page Numbers

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/page-numbers

Insert page numbers in the position you choose

Add page numbers to PDF online for free. Choose one of six positions, the number to start counting from, and the font size; numbers are plain digits (1, 2, 3). No watermarks, no sign-up.

### Bates Numbering

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/bates-numbering

Add Bates Numbers for legal document indexing

Add Bates numbering to PDF for legal document indexing. Apply sequential Bates stamps with custom prefix, suffix, and start number to single or batches of PDFs. Essential for legal discovery and court filings. Free online tool.

### Bookmarks

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/bookmarks

Add bookmarks to navigate large files

Add bookmarks to PDF online — give each entry a title and a page, or paste the whole list as JSON, for easier navigation in large documents. The new bookmarks replace any the PDF already has and appear as a clickable outline in the reader's sidebar. Free, no software installation.

### Compress PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/compress-pdf

Reduce the file size of your PDF

Compress PDF online for free. Choose a compression preset and compare the resulting file size. Savings and visual quality depend on the original PDF and selected settings; review the output before sharing. Server upload and capacity limits apply.

### Remove Watermark

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/remove-watermark

Find and remove visible watermarks from a PDF

Remove watermark from PDF online for free. Detects text watermarks — diagonal stamps, CONFIDENTIAL and DRAFT marks — shows you exactly what it found, and removes only what you confirm. Lossless where the PDF allows it: the rest of the page is left untouched. No sign-up.

### Flatten PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/flatten-pdf

Flatten forms and annotations into PDF content

Flatten PDF online — permanently merge interactive form fields and annotations into static page content. Essential for submitting filled forms, preventing further edits in a PDF reader, and ensuring consistent display. Links stay clickable and layers are left as they are. Free tool.

### Deskew PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/deskew-pdf

Straighten scanned pages that are slightly tilted

Deskew scanned PDF pages online for free. Automatically detect and correct the tilt angle of scanned documents so the lines of text run straight. Ideal for fixing wonky scans. No installation required.

### Repair PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/repair-pdf

Attempt to fix corrupted PDF files

Repair corrupted PDF files online for free. Rebuild damaged or broken PDFs that won't open in standard PDF readers and recover the content that is still intact. No software download needed.

### Resize PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/resize-pdf

Change the physical dimensions of the pages

Resize PDF pages online — change page dimensions to A4, Letter, A3, Legal, or a custom size in points. The content is not scaled: it keeps its size and its place at the bottom-left of the page, so a larger page adds space at the top and right, and a smaller one cuts off what falls outside it. Free PDF page resizer with no watermarks.

### Rotate PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/rotate-pdf

Rotate all or specific pages in the PDF

Rotate PDF pages online for free — rotate individual pages or all pages by 90°, 180°, or 270°. Fix sideways or upside-down scanned documents instantly. Rotate every page or just the pages you list. No sign-up required.

### Grayscale PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/grayscale-pdf

Convert a colorful PDF to black and white

Convert PDF to grayscale online for free — turn color PDFs into black and white. Save ink when printing or prepare documents for monochrome printing. Photos are converted in place, so black text stays sharp and searchable; if any text or drawing is in color, every page is turned into a grayscale image instead.

### Crop PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/crop-pdf

Trim the margins or change the visible area

Crop PDF online for free — trim margins, remove white space, or change the visible area of PDF pages. Draw a crop box to remove unwanted borders. Perfect for removing headers, footers, or excess whitespace.

### Protect PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/protect-pdf

Encrypt a PDF with a password or set permissions

Password protect PDF online for free — encrypt your PDF with AES-256 encryption. Set an open password and control printing, copying, and editing access. No sign-up needed.

### Unlock PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/unlock-pdf

Remove password protection from a PDF

Remove password from PDF online for free. Unlock password-protected PDFs you own by entering the correct password. Remove restrictions on printing, copying, and editing. Fast, secure, no software required.

### Redact PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/redact-pdf

Permanently black out sensitive content

Redact PDF online for free — permanently black out sensitive information including names, addresses, SSNs, and confidential text. WARNING: Redaction is irreversible — the text and image pixels under each box are erased from the file, not just hidden.

### Strip Metadata

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/strip-metadata

Remove embedded metadata for privacy

Remove metadata from PDF online — strip author name, creation date, GPS coordinates, software info, and the rest of the document's Info and XMP metadata before sharing documents. Metadata inside embedded images is not removed. Free, instant, no sign-up.

### Delete Annotations

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/delete-annotations

Remove all comments, highlights, and annotations

Remove all annotations from PDF online — delete highlights, comments, sticky notes, drawings, and markup from your documents. Clean up reviewed PDFs before final distribution. Free and private.

### Metadata

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/metadata

View and edit document metadata

View and edit PDF metadata online for free — read the Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer and date fields, and change the first four. See exactly what information is embedded in your PDF before sharing.

### HTML to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/html-to-pdf

Convert web pages or HTML code into a PDF

Convert HTML to PDF online for free. Paste HTML code or enter a public web address and download the result as a PDF document. Pasted HTML keeps its CSS, including stylesheets and images linked by full http(s) addresses, and its clickable links; a web address is rendered from the page's HTML alone, without external stylesheets, images, or JavaScript. No installation required.

### Image to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/image-to-pdf

Convert JPG, PNG, or other images into a PDF

Convert images to PDF online for free — combine JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, or BMP images into a single PDF document. Choose Auto, where each page matches its image, or fit every image onto A4 or Letter pages. Bulk convert multiple images at once. Location and camera details are removed.

### JPG to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/jpg-to-pdf

Convert JPG / JPEG photos into a single PDF

Convert JPG to PDF online for free — combine one or many JPEG photos into a single PDF document, with pages sized to each photo or to A4 or Letter. Bulk convert phone photos, scans, or screenshots in seconds. Up to 100 images and 200 MB per PDF, which is roughly 50 phone photos; no watermarks, no sign-up. Sideways phone photos are turned upright, and location and camera details are removed.

### PNG to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/png-to-pdf

Convert PNG images into a single PDF document

Convert PNG to PDF online for free — turn one or more PNG images into a single PDF, one image per page (transparent areas are not kept). Bulk convert screenshots, design exports, or charts. Pixels are stored losslessly at 8 bits per channel; no watermark, no sign-up. Text notes, location and camera details are removed.

### HEIC to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/heic-to-pdf

Convert iPhone HEIC photos into a single PDF

Convert HEIC to PDF online for free — turn iPhone HEIC / HEIF photos into a standard PDF document. Combine multiple HEIC photos into one PDF without first converting them to JPG. Perfect for receipts, scans, and travel documents from iOS. Location and camera details are removed.

### WebP to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/webp-to-pdf

Convert modern WebP images into a PDF

Convert WebP to PDF online for free — turn one or more Google WebP images into a single PDF document. Faster downloads, smaller files, but most viewers still expect PDF — convert in seconds with no quality loss. Location and camera details are removed.

### TIFF to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/tiff-to-pdf

Convert TIFF / TIF scans into a single PDF

Convert TIFF to PDF online for free — combine TIFF scans, fax images, or archival photos into one PDF, one page per file (only the first page of a multi-page TIFF is used). Ideal for healthcare, legal, and government workflows that ship TIFF but need PDF for distribution. Camera, author and location details in TIFF tags are removed.

### BMP to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/bmp-to-pdf

Convert Windows BMP bitmaps into a PDF

Convert BMP to PDF online for free — turn legacy Windows bitmap images into a standard PDF document for sharing. Combine multiple BMPs into one PDF or convert each individually. Up to 100 images, 200 MB and 750 megapixels per PDF. Only the pixels are copied: no location or camera details.

### GIF to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/gif-to-pdf

Convert GIF images into a single PDF

Convert GIF to PDF online for free — turn one or more GIF images into a PDF document. The first frame of animated GIFs is used. Combine memes, screenshots, and graphics into a single PDF. Only the pixels are copied: no comments, location or camera details.

### SVG to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/svg-to-pdf

Convert SVG vector graphics into PDF

Convert SVG to PDF online for free — turn SVG icons, logos, charts, and diagrams into a PDF. Each SVG becomes one page, drawn as a high-resolution image 2400 pixels wide: sharp at normal sizes, though no longer vector, so its text cannot be selected. Handy for sharing design exports with people who expect a PDF. The files' metadata is removed.

### ODT to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/odt-to-pdf

Convert OpenDocument (ODT) into PDF

Convert ODT to PDF online for free — turn OpenDocument Text files (LibreOffice / OpenOffice / Google Docs exports) into a PDF with LibreOffice, which turns headings into bookmarks; fonts the server does not have are replaced with substitutes, which can move line and page breaks.

### Office to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/office-to-pdf

Convert Word, Excel, or PowerPoint to PDF

Convert Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to PDF online for free. Upload a Microsoft Office document (.doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, or .pptx) and LibreOffice converts it to a PDF that keeps its layout, tables, charts, and images. Fonts the server does not have are replaced with similar ones.

### PDF to Excel

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-excel

Best-effort table/text extraction into a spreadsheet

Convert PDF to Excel online for free — extract tables and data from PDF documents into editable XLSX spreadsheets, with one sheet per page. Best-effort extraction works best on tables drawn with ruled lines; a page without a table keeps its text instead.

### PDF to Image

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-image

Convert each PDF page into an image file

Convert PDF to images online for free — render each page as a high-resolution JPG or PNG image. Choose 72, 150 or 300 DPI and the output format. Perfect for thumbnails, previews, and social media.

### PDF to Long Image

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-long-image

Stitch every PDF page into one tall image

Turn a whole PDF into a single long image online for free — every page is rendered and stacked vertically into one tall PNG or JPG, ready to share or scroll. Unlike PDF-to-Image (one file per page), this gives you the entire document as a single picture. Runs on the PrivaTools server; the file is cleaned up after the response.

### PDF to TIFF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-tiff

Convert PDF into a multi-page TIFF image

Convert PDF to TIFF online for free — export your PDF as a single multi-page TIFF image, ideal for archival and document workflows that require TIFF. Pages are rendered in color at 200 DPI and bundle into one .tif file with deflate compression.

### PDF to BMP

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-bmp

Render PDF pages as Windows BMP bitmaps

Convert PDF to BMP online for free — render each page as a Windows BMP bitmap. Useful for legacy software and older Windows tooling that doesn't accept modern image formats.

### PDF to GIF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-gif

Render PDF pages as GIF images

Convert PDF to GIF online for free — render each page as a GIF image. Great for embedding PDF page snapshots in chat apps, forums, or wikis where GIFs are first-class.

### PDF to SVG

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-svg

Convert PDF pages into editable SVG vectors

Convert PDF to SVG online for free — turn each PDF page into a true SVG vector that scales infinitely without quality loss. Perfect for design workflows, web embedding, and editing in Illustrator, Inkscape, or Figma.

### PDF to JPG

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-jpg

Render PDF pages as JPG photos

Convert PDF to JPG online for free — render each PDF page as a high-quality JPG image. Each page comes out at 150 DPI, one JPG per page. Perfect for thumbnails, social media previews, or photo-style sharing.

### PDF to PNG

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-png

Render PDF pages as lossless PNG images

Convert PDF to PNG online for free — render each PDF page as a PNG image at 150 DPI. PNG is lossless, so text and line art keep their sharp edges, making it ideal for screenshots, charts, and design exports. Pages are rendered on a white background.

### PDF to PowerPoint

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-pptx

Convert each PDF page into a PowerPoint slide image

Convert PDF to PowerPoint online for free — create a PPTX presentation where each page becomes a slide. Great for presenting PDF content in meetings. Each page is rendered as a high-quality slide image.

### PDF to Text

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-text

Extract all text from a PDF file

Extract text from PDF online for free — pull all readable text content from your PDF into a clean plain-text document. Works with both text-based and searchable PDFs. No sign-up, instant results.

### PDF to Word

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-word

Convert PDF content to an editable Word draft

Convert PDF to Word online for free. Extract the text line by line, with its fonts, sizes and colours, plus images, into an editable DOCX document. Paragraphs, spacing and tables are not rebuilt, so expect some cleanup after conversion. Files use temporary server processing; upload and capacity limits apply.

### Alternate Mix

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/alternate-mix

Mix pages of two PDFs alternately

Alternate mix PDF pages online — interleave pages from two PDFs for duplex scanning workflows. Combine front-side and back-side scans into the correct page order. Free tool, no sign-up.

### Compare PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/compare-pdf

Visually compare two PDF documents

Compare two PDFs online for free — upload two versions of a document and get a visual diff that highlights the areas that changed on each page, or a line-by-line text diff of additions and deletions. Essential for contract review, version control, and proofreading.

### Extract Images

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/extract-images

Extract the embedded images from a PDF

Extract images from PDF online for free — detect and download the embedded images in your PDF as individual files, mostly PNG or JPEG. Get photos, scanned pages, and raster logos out of any PDF document; vector drawings are not images and are not extracted.

### Fill Form

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/fill-form

Fill out interactive PDF forms and save them

Fill PDF forms online for free — open interactive PDF forms, fill in all text fields, checkboxes, and dropdowns, then save the completed document. No Adobe Acrobat needed. Your PDF must have existing form fields.

### N-Up PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/nup

Print multiple pages per sheet

Print multiple PDF pages per sheet online — arrange 2, 4, 6, 9, or 16 pages onto a single sheet for compact printing. Save paper and create handouts. Free N-Up PDF tool with no watermarks.

### OCR PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/ocr-pdf

Extract text or create a searchable PDF using OCR

OCR PDF online for free — convert scanned documents into searchable, selectable text using Tesseract OCR. The server engine reads 17 languages, including English, Hindi, Spanish, and French, and the in-browser engine offers 45. Output as searchable PDF or plain text.

### Overlay PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/overlay

Overlay one PDF onto another (e.g., letterhead)

Overlay PDF pages online — layer one PDF document on top of another. Perfect for adding letterhead, branded backgrounds, or watermark stamps to existing PDFs. Free, private, no installation required.

### QR Code Generator

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/qr-code

Generate QR codes — download as PNG or PDF

Generate QR codes online for free — encode any URL, contact card, WiFi credentials, or plain text into a QR code. Download it as a PNG image or a one-page PDF, choose the size and colours, and optionally add a small centre logo. Standard QR with built-in error correction that phone cameras can read.

### PDF to PDF/A

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-pdfa

Save a cleaned copy labelled PDF/A-2b for archiving

Convert PDF to PDF/A online for free — the tool re-saves your PDF with a cleaned-up structure and marks it as PDF/A-2b in its XMP metadata. It does not embed fonts, add a colour profile or check the file against the standard, so validate the result before you rely on it for legal, government or archive submissions.

### Remove Blank Pages

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/remove-blank-pages

Scan and delete entirely blank or near-blank pages

Remove blank pages from PDF online for free. Automatically scan and delete entirely blank or near-blank pages from scanned documents. Clean up your PDFs by removing empty filler pages left over from scanning.

### Auto-Crop PDF (Remove Margins)

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/auto-crop

Auto-detect content and trim margins from every page

Auto-crop PDF online for free — automatically detect the content bounding box on every page and trim the surrounding whitespace. Ideal for reading PDFs on e-readers, tablets, or phones where screen space is limited. Also called Remove Margins. Free tool, no sign-up.

### PDF to EPUB

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-epub

Convert a PDF into the EPUB format for e-readers

Convert PDF to EPUB online for free — package the text and images of every page into one basic EPUB e-book file, in page order. Text keeps its font sizes, bold, italics, and colors; there are no chapters, the contents list names each page, and bookmarks are not carried over.

### Markdown / Config to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/markdown-to-pdf

Convert a Markdown document to PDF

Convert Markdown to PDF online. Upload a .md, .markdown, or .txt document for temporary server-side rendering, then download the generated PDF. Review formatting and links in the output before sharing.

### CSV to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/csv-to-pdf

Turn CSV data into a clean PDF table

Convert CSV to PDF online for free — upload a CSV spreadsheet and generate a cleanly formatted PDF table, with the first row as a bold header and striped rows. Instant conversion, no sign-up, free to use.

### Word to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/word-to-pdf

Convert .docx Word documents to PDF

Convert Word to PDF online for free — upload .docx documents and get a simple PDF of their text on A4 pages, with headings set in larger bold type and paragraphs that contain bold or italic text set that way. Images, tables, headers and footers, links, fonts and alignment are not carried over; for a copy closer to the original, use Office to PDF. No Microsoft Office needed.

### Excel to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/excel-to-pdf

Convert .xlsx spreadsheets to PDF

Convert Excel to PDF online for free — upload .xlsx spreadsheets and convert every sheet into a simple PDF table: the sheet name as a title, the first row in bold, a line under each row, and equal-width columns. No Microsoft Office required.

### PowerPoint to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pptx-to-pdf-convert

Convert .pptx presentations to PDF

Convert PowerPoint to PDF online for free — upload .pptx presentations and get a PDF with one page per slide at the slide's own size, holding the text from each slide's text boxes. Pictures, tables, charts, and most formatting are not carried over. No Microsoft Office required.

### Text to PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/txt-to-pdf

Convert plain text .txt files to PDF

Convert text to PDF online for free — upload .txt files and get a cleanly formatted PDF with monospace font, word wrap, and proper pagination. Instant conversion, no sign-up required.

### PDF Stamp

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/stamp-pdf

Add CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT, or custom stamps

Add stamps to PDF online for free — apply CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT, APPROVED, COPY, VOID, or custom text stamps to any page. Adjustable opacity and position; the size is set automatically from the page width. No sign-up, no watermarks.

### E-Sign PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/esign-pdf

Quick draw-and-place signature on any PDF

E-sign PDF online for free — draw your signature with mouse or finger, then place it on any page. The simplest way to electronically sign documents without printing. No account needed.

### PDF Table Extractor

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/extract-tables

Extract tables from PDF pages to CSV

Extract tables from PDF to CSV online for free. Automatically detect tables drawn with ruled lines in invoices, reports, and financial statements and extract them into one editable CSV file.

### PDF to Markdown

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/pdf-to-markdown

Extract PDF content as clean Markdown format

Convert PDF to Markdown online for free — extract content with automatic heading detection, bold text preservation, and clean formatting. Perfect for converting documents to web content, wikis, and documentation.

### White-Out / Eraser

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/whiteout-pdf

Cover content on PDF with white boxes

White-out content in PDF online — place white rectangles over text, images, or any content to cover it visually. Works like digital correction tape; the underlying text stays in the file, so use Redact PDF for true removal.

### Annotate PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/annotate-pdf

Add highlights, underlines, and sticky notes

Annotate PDF online for free — add highlights, underlines, strikethrough, and sticky notes with customizable colors. Perfect for reviewing documents, studying, and collaborative feedback. No software needed.

### Highlight PDF

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/highlight-pdf

Highlight every match of a word or phrase

Highlight PDF online for free — search for any word or phrase and apply a real PDF Highlight annotation to every occurrence at once. Pick from yellow, green, pink, blue, or orange. Works on multi-page documents and preserves the highlight as a fully-editable annotation in any PDF reader.

### Summarize PDF (AI)

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/summarize-pdf

Summarize with a local model or your own AI provider

Summarize PDF text using an on-device model or your own AI provider connection. The local model runs in your browser after its initial download. Provider mode sends extracted text directly to your selected provider and may incur provider charges. Choose the summary length and review the result against the original; scanned PDFs may need OCR first.

### Smart Redact (AI)

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/smart-redact

Find possible personal data, review, then apply redactions

Find possible personal information in PDF text. Pattern detection runs in your browser; names can be suggested by a local model or your selected AI provider. Already detected pattern values are masked before provider requests. Review every suggestion: detection can miss information. Applying your selection uploads the PDF and selected terms to the backend for permanent redaction.

### Chat with PDF (AI)

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/chat-with-pdf

Chat with a PDF online — free and private. The text is extracted by pdf.js inside your browser and each question goes straight from your browser to the AI provider you choose (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Together AI, or a model server on your own computer), using your own API key. ### Verify Digital Signature

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/verify-signature

Check that a PDF's signatures still match the file

Verify PDF digital signatures online. Every signature field is listed, and each signature shows the signer's name as recorded and the signing time. Each signature in a supported format is checked: whether the signed content has changed, whether the signature matches its certificate, whose subject and issuer are shown, and what was saved to the file afterwards, such as form filling, further signatures or edits to the pages. Certificates are not checked against a trust list or for revocation, so a valid result does not prove who signed; confirm that in a PDF reader that validates certificates. Free tool.

### Sanitize Document

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/sanitize-pdf

Remove scripts, attachments and hidden layers from a PDF

Sanitize PDF online — remove the parts of a PDF that can run code, reach outside the file or hide content: document JavaScript, actions that run by themselves (except opening at a set page), links and buttons that launch programs, open other files, submit form data or use javascript: or file: addresses, embedded file attachments, sound, video and 3D content, XFA form data, and anything in a layer that is switched off. The document information fields and XMP metadata are cleared too. Visible layers become ordinary page content, form fields stay fillable, and web, email and in-document links keep working. The file is rewritten, so a digital signature in it will no longer validate.

### Hidden Text Checker

URL: https://privatools.me/tool/hidden-text-checker

Find text in a PDF that readers can't see

Find hidden text in a PDF online for free: text a reader can't see but search, copy and paste, screening software and AI models still read. It finds text set to be invisible or fully transparent, text in the colour of what lies behind it (white on white), text too small to read, text off the page or clipped away, text in layers that are switched off, text under a box, shape or image drawn over it (a redaction that left the words in the file), text in hidden comments and form fields, and redaction marks that were never applied. Each finding gives the page, the reason and the exact words, highlighted on a preview of the page, and the report downloads as text or JSON. Invisible text over scanned pages, which OCR adds, is listed separately. A clean result means none of these checks matched, not that the file is safe in every way. The PDF is checked on our server in temporary storage, up to 500 pages, and is not changed.

Perfect for email attachments and web upload limits. Transparency is not kept: see-through areas usually turn black, so add a background first if you need white.

### JPG to WebP

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/jpg-to-webp

Convert JPG to WebP for smaller, web-optimized files

Convert JPEG images to WebP for web delivery. Output size and quality depend on the source image and encoder settings; compare the result before replacing the original.

### PNG to WebP

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/png-to-webp

Convert PNG to WebP — smaller files, transparency preserved

Convert PNG to WebP online for free — WebP supports transparency like PNG but with 25–50% smaller file sizes. Perfect for web graphics and PWAs. The output is lossy WebP, so keep the PNG if you need a pixel-perfect copy.

### TIFF to JPG

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/tiff-to-jpg

Convert TIFF to JPG for sharing and email

Convert TIFF to JPG online for free — TIFF is a large, lossless format used in archival and pro photography; JPEG is universally compatible. Typical 5–10x size reduction. For a multi-page TIFF, only the first page is converted.

### TIFF to PNG

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/tiff-to-png

Convert TIFF to PNG — lossless, transparency preserved

Convert TIFF to PNG online for free — both are lossless formats, but PNG is universally supported in browsers and modern software. Transparency channel preserved when present.

### BMP to JPG

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/bmp-to-jpg

Convert BMP bitmap to JPG — massive size reduction

Convert BMP to JPG online for free — BMP is the uncompressed Windows bitmap format and is HUGE. JPEG conversion typically gives 50–100x smaller files with no visible quality loss at standard viewing sizes.

### BMP to PNG

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/bmp-to-png

Convert BMP bitmap to PNG — lossless, much smaller

Convert BMP images to PNG, which uses lossless compression and is broadly supported by browsers and image editors. Output size depends on the original bitmap.

### GIF to JPG

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/gif-to-jpg

Convert GIF to JPG (uses the first frame)

Convert GIF to JPG online for free — extracts the first frame of an animated GIF (or the single frame of a static GIF) as a JPEG. Useful for thumbnails, social media uploads, or anywhere GIF isn't supported.

### GIF to PNG

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/gif-to-png

Convert GIF to PNG (preserves transparency)

Convert GIF to PNG online for free — extracts the first frame as a PNG, preserving transparency. PNG offers much higher color fidelity than GIF's 256-color limit.

### M4A to MP3

Convert iPhone M4A voice memos and audio to MP3

Convert M4A to MP3 online for free — M4A is Apple's audio format (used by iPhone Voice Memos and iTunes); MP3 plays everywhere. Powered by FFmpeg, encoded at 192 kbps. Files up to 200 MB supported.

### MP4 to MP3

Extract audio from MP4 video and save as MP3

Convert MP4 to MP3 online for free — extract the audio track from any MP4 video and save it as an MP3 file. Useful for ripping music from YouTube downloads, podcast clips, or lecture recordings. Encoded at about 128 kbps.

### MOV to MP4

URL: https://privatools.me/tools/mov-to-mp4

Convert MOV to MP4 online for free — MOV is Apple's QuickTime container; MP4 plays on every device including Windows, Android, web browsers, and social media. H.264 video + AAC audio for best compatibility.

### AVI to MP4

### WebM to MP4

### MP4 to WebM
